new_developments.summary: Iran says Hormuz deal with Oman 'very close' (Aug 9). Reopening tied to US compensation. First meaningful de-escalation signal since war began Feb 2026.

events.title: US-Japan Joint Currency Intervention — Ongoing, FIMA Repo Active
events.details: Joint US-Japan intervention confirmed Aug 2-3. Japan sold ~$58.97B to buy yen. Using Fed FIMA repo facility. BOJ held rates at 1% (8-1 vote). BOJ accelerating tightening timeline. Yen at ~158, BoA sees ¥149 by year-end.
events.source: CNBC, Al Jazeera, Fortune, Japan Times

events.title: US-South Korea-Japan Trilateral Currency Intervention — Stabilizing
events.details: Won hits 9-month high. KRW best performing Asian currency. Joint intervention with US and Japan. Carry trade risks persist but semiconductor demand supporting.

events.title: 2026 Strait of Hormuz Crisis — DE-ESCALATION SIGNAL
events.details: War Day 163. Hormuz at 2% pre-war traffic. Iran says Oman deal 'very close' (Aug 9). Reopening tied to US compensation for MoU violations. Iran parliament reviewing ban on US/Israeli ships + toll charges. Trump admin rejected plan. First meaningful de-escalation signal.
events.source: Wikipedia, The Hill, ABC News, Economic Times, Tribune India, NPR

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic — WHO PHEIC, Outbreak Outpacing Response
events.details: PHEIC declared May 16/17. 1,801 deaths in DRC, 2 in Uganda. WHO chief says outbreak outpacing response. Health workers striking. MSF running PARTNERS clinical trial. Bundibugyo virus strain.
events.source: Wikipedia, ECDC, CDC, MSF, Spectrum Local News

events.title: Japan JGB Yields Surge — Fiscal Crisis Risk Deepening
events.details: Takaichi food tax cut costing ¥4.4T revenue. ¥1.3438 quadrillion debt exposed. BOJ normalization driving yields higher. Morningstar DBRS says risks 'manageable' but favorable debt dynamics is key challenge. US feared forced Treasury selling.

events.title: Argentina Country Risk Rising — IMF Payment Wall + Brazil Diplomatic Crisis
events.details: Country risk at 451 bps (highest since June). ~$3B IMF payments due rest of 2026, doubling in 2027. Brazil withdrew ambassador from Argentina. Merval -2.61%. Bilateral trade threatened.
events.source: PIIE, Rio Times Online, Buenos Aires Herald

events.title: China Property Crisis + Currency Undervaluation
events.details: PBOC pledging 'timely' policy adjustment, 'appropriately loose' monetary policy. Property crisis ongoing since 2020. CFR estimates yuan undervalued 20%+. Beijing trimmed 2026 growth forecast. Stabilizing property, local debt, small banks.

events.title: Private Credit Market — $1.8T Systemic Risk, Averting Worst Fears
events.details: Bloomberg (Aug 6): private credit funds 'avert worst fears and rebound from lows.' 10.6% of BDC-held companies show credit stress. Regulatory oversight gaps flagged by American Banker. Federal regulatory bodies face workforce reductions.

us_fed.notes: Fed held rates at 3.5-3.75% in July. Next FOMC Sept 16. No emergency moves.

latam.notes: Argentina country risk 451 bps, IMF wall, Brazil diplomatic crisis.

eu_ecb.notes: ECB raised rates in June 2026. No emergency. Lending rates 3.6% firms, 4.0% market debt.

uk.notes: Gilts fell to 4.9% (lowest since July 10). Bailey downplaying hikes. Oil decline helping.

japan.notes: Joint intervention ongoing. JGB crisis. BOJ accelerating tightening. Takaichi fiscal expansion risky.

china.notes: PBOC loose policy. Property crisis. Currency undervalued 20%+. Growth trimmed.

em_asia.notes: Won at 9-month high. Trilateral intervention working. Semis supporting KRW.

middle_east.notes: Hormuz deal with Oman 'very close'. Reopening tied to US concessions. War Day 163.

africa.notes: Nigeria-SA xenophobic tensions. 109K deportations. No coups. Ghana cancelled Ramaphosa visit.

financial_system.notes: Private credit averting worst fears. Regulatory oversight gaps. Russian bankruptcies +13.7%.

commodities.notes: Brent $78.18 (+6.34% monthly). Gold at monthly high on peace hopes. Oil declining on de-escalation.

pandemic_health.notes: Ebola PHEIC. 1,801 deaths. Outbreak outpacing response. Health workers striking.
